column1: # Club nicknames and short names -> full club name, for query expansion (M2-10).
# Format: alias<TAB>expansion. Matching is case- and accent-insensitive on whole
# words, longest alias first. Hand-curated common knowledge; see
# Deliberately left out: ambiguous aliases such as "blues" (Chelsea? Everton?
# Birmingham?) and "wanderers" (Wolves? Bolton?). A wrong expansion costs more
# precision than a missing one costs recall.
